whatItDoes: The Shure MV7X is a professional-quality dynamic microphone, ideal for close mic applications that require vocal intelligibility with a balanced tone.
pros: The attractive and durable all-metal design features an adjustable yoke that can be mounted onto a variety of microphone stands for flexible placement options.
Highly directional cardioid pattern isolates your voice and removes unwanted background noise.
The MV7X features a dynamic capsule with a cardioid pattern, which uses Voice Isolation Technology to pick up sound directly in front of the microphone.

specifications.name: Sensitivity
specifications.value: -55 dBV/Pa [1] (1.78 mV) (@ 1 kHz, open circuit voltage)

specifications.name: Polarity
specifications.value: Positive pressure on diaphragm produces positive voltage on pin 2 with respect to pin 3

compatibility: Passive XLR output: Connect to XLR mixers and interfaces.
